title: Claude Code Telegram k8s
description: Claude Code integration with Telegram for sprint notifications and bot interactions.
longDescription: Setup a Telegram bot connected to Claude Code for receiving sprint updates, notifications, and interacting with the development workflow directly from Telegram.

title: Telegram Bot: Build-Ready Image
description: Publish a Docker image for the Telegram bot that includes .NET and React so Claude Code can build the portfolio project inside the cluster.
longDescription: The Telegram bot is already deployed — this task is about shipping a new Docker image that has .NET and React pre-installed alongside Claude Code. This gives the bot everything it needs to build, test, and run the portfolio project directly from within the cluster without relying on external build agents.

title: Claude Telegram: Initial Rules
description: Begin configuring Claude Code rules and behaviours on the k8s Telegram bot.
longDescription: Define the initial CLAUDE.md rules and agent configuration for the k8s-hosted Claude Code Telegram bot — covering what commands it can run, how it interacts with the repo, and any safety boundaries.

title: Claude GitHub Issue Agent
description: Scheduled Claude job that monitors new issues and comments, letting users iterate with AI directly via GitHub.
longDescription: A scheduled agent that watches for new GitHub issues and issue comments. When triggered, Claude reads the thread, understands the context, and responds — allowing users to describe bugs, request features, or ask questions entirely through GitHub issues without ever touching the codebase. Closes the loop between public users and the AI-assisted development workflow.

title: GitHub Actions: Docker Build & Push
description: GitHub Actions workflows for building and pushing Docker images on commit.
longDescription: CI workflows that build Docker images for the frontend and backend on push, and publish them to a container registry. Foundation for the full automated deploy pipeline.

title: Oracle K8s Cluster
description: Custom Kubernetes environment on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.
longDescription: The foundation for the new ecosystem. A fully functional K8s cluster providing scalable and cost-effective hosting.

title: Move to .NET
description: Migrating core services to .NET for improved performance and scalability.
longDescription: Transitioning the backend architecture to .NET to leverage its robust ecosystem and performance benefits.

title: Create Template Project
description: Standardizing project starts with a robust template.
longDescription: Building a reusable template that includes authentication, logging, and deployment configs to speed up new app development.

title: Local Continuous Deployment
description: Script-based deployments for rapid iterations.
longDescription: I've chosen to implement a local scripting approach for CD instead of complex CI pipelines. This allows for faster deployments and less overhead while working solo, while still providing automated and repeatable updates to the K8s cluster.

title: Dev Environment
description: Isolated staging and local development environments.
longDescription: Setting up a mirrored dev environment to test features safely before production rollout.

title: Per-App Newsletters
description: Targeted updates and subscription management for individual projects.
longDescription: Infrastructure to handle segmented email lists, allowing users to follow specific apps or the general ecosystem.

title: User Idea Submission
description: A transparent board for users to post and vote on new app features or project ideas.
longDescription: Closing the feedback loop by allowing the community to directly influence the nursery roadmap and prioritize new builds.

title: Sprint Status History
description: Indicate changes in task status between sprints on the website.
longDescription: Implement a feature on the website to visualize how tasks move between statuses across sprints, providing historical context and progress tracking.

title: Upgrade Node Memory to 12GB
description: Increase cluster node memory from 8GB to 12GB to fully leverage the free OKE tier.
longDescription: Oracle's free OKE tier supports up to 12GB of memory per node. Upgrading from the current 8GB will give more headroom for running additional workloads and improve overall cluster stability.

title: Newsletter-to-Beta Automation
description: Automated public beta onboarding via newsletter signup.
longDescription: Mechanism where users signing up to the newsletter are automatically added to iOS/Android beta groups via App Store Connect and Play Store APIs.

title: Sprint Data Migration
description: Migrate all sprint logs and goals from JSON to the PostgreSQL database.
longDescription: Move the sprints.json data model into a proper relational database schema for scalability, querying, and long-term maintainability.

title: User Persistence (Cookies)
description: Remember user emails via cookies to streamline interest registration.
longDescription: Improve returning visitor experience by persisting email addresses via browser cookies, reducing friction for users who previously registered interest.

title: User Verification Flow
description: Implement magic link or button verification flow for registered interest.
longDescription: A lightweight verification mechanism (magic link or email button) to confirm user intent when they register interest in an app, improving the quality of beta sign-ups.

title: User Subscription Management
description: Self-service portal for users to manage project interests and beta access.
longDescription: A platform feature allowing users to manage their own subscriptions, opt-in/out of project-specific newsletters, and claim or release beta testing spots via a secure, token-based management page.

title: Setup Webhooks with Claude
description: Configure Claude Code hooks to automate build, deploy, and notification triggers across the portfolio project.
longDescription: Wire up Claude Code's hooks system to fire on key events — post-commit, post-deploy, and issue creation. Enables automated sprint updates, Telegram notifications, and deployment triggers all driven by Claude Code without manual intervention.

title: Webhook Deployment Server
description: Authenticated web server for triggering rollout restarts without exposing the control plane.
longDescription: A lightweight authenticated web server running inside the cluster that accepts deploy webhook calls from GitHub Actions. Triggers rollout restarts on deployments and stateful sets — allowing a full build/publish/deploy pipeline without granting GitHub any direct access to the k8s control plane.

title: Web Template: Claude Onboarding
description: Onboard Claude Code to the web template repo — CLAUDE.md, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and general cleanup.
longDescription: Apply the same Claude Code setup used in this repo to the web template project: add CLAUDE.md with project conventions, wire up GitHub Actions for Docker build and push, clean up any stale docs or config, and ensure the template is in a clean state to serve as the starting point for future projects.
